parameters.name: dab_10kw_assembly
parameters.description: 10 kW DAB converter mechanical layout in one coordinate system: aluminium chassis plate, four plate-fin heat sinks (two per bridge, fins through chassis cut-outs), primary and secondary power boards above their heat sinks, transformer on the chassis between them, control board above the transformer, DC input/output terminal blocks. Illustrative layout for interference/clearance checking, not a manufacturable assembly.

heatsink.name: dab_heatsink
heatsink.description: Plate-fin aluminium heat sink for one SiC half-bridge: two TO-247-4L devices on alumina isolation pads, M3 screw holes, four M4 corner mounting holes. Fins hang down from the base (z < 0). Illustrative model.

clearance_pairs.note: illustrative functional-insulation value between device tabs/leads and the earthed heat sink

params.name: dab_transformer
params.description: 10 kW DAB transformer (800 V : 400 V, 100 kHz): E65/32/27 ferrite pair, 21:10 turns, litz primary, copper-foil secondary, polyimide inter-winding barrier and margins, pin terminals, clips and base plate. Illustrative parametric model, not a manufacturable design.

core.reference: TDK E 65/32/27 core (B66387), data sheet https://www.tdk-electronics.tdk.com/inf/80/db/fer/e_65_32_27.pdf (Oct 2024): Sigma l/A 0.27 mm^-1, le 147 mm, Ae 535 mm^2, Amin 529 mm^2, Ve 78650 mm^3, approx. 394 g/set. Nominal outline letters A=65.2, B=32.6, C=44.2, D=22.2, E=20.0, F=27.4 mm are transcribed from the IEC 62317-8 E65/32/27 outline reproduced in that drawing and must be verified against the current revision; the model is fully parametric.

clearance_pairs.note: illustrative caller-supplied values for the 800 V primary to 400 V secondary isolation; not a standard assertion
illustrative functional-insulation value to earthed core/mounting parts
illustrative caller-supplied reinforced-isolation values between the 800 V and 400 V circuits; not a standard assertion

check_summary.note: required clearance/creepage values are caller inputs; no standard compliance is asserted
